scientific_intent.scientific_task: Find minimum total positive edge weight from source vertex 0 to every reachable vertex, retaining unreachable sentinels.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: d[v] = min over source-to-v paths of sum positive edge weights; source represents negative distance and applies atomicMax(cost[v],cost[u]-weight[u,v]).
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: NYR directed CSR graph264346vertices733846edges, maximumdegree8; source hybrid CPU/GPU frontier queues and workgroup local capacity1600.
scientific_intent.independent_validation: CPU binary-heap Dijkstra, complete Bellman inequalities and tight-predecessor witness plus exact source expected NYR distances; independent full output for every selected trial.
scientific_intent.scientific_scope: Unique graph distance solution on four declared graphs/configurations, not arbitrary graph capacity, negative cycles, geographic units, formal concurrent memory-model safety or application-level road routing validation.

keyconfounds: Dependent host readback/launch/CPU-worker control; common original CPU functions via shared CPU-only CABI, not full Julia CPU reimplementation.
Dynamic queue order, frontier counts and CPU/GPU work partition vary between trials; matched algorithm/initial bytes/ROI does not imply identical operation counts.
Otherwise-unused queue initialization, guards and packed scalar allocation are qualified reference/integration adaptations; original source GPU body unchanged, exclude untouched-native aggregates.
Int32 source plain loads mixed with atomic updates; finite named-case certificate is not formal race freedom/all-graphs proof.
JACC shared(seed) adds timed6412B per-block preload and extra barrier; selected source mapping/resource policy covariate, not a universal frontend limitation.
Source ROI sums completed CPU and GPU compute segments; transfers/controller/checks/output outside, not total CLI wall time.
New captures reside under /tmp with canonical run symlink receipts; preserve before machine cleanup.
